source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design — Mandarin Grade 8 (First published 2023, Revised 2024)
source.notes: kicd.ac.ke's grade-eight-designs page embeds this exact PDF via Google Drive file id 1KxyvR6lreOFJQ8LcdFuWCQteJvSUGJrI (title confirmed via WebFetch on the Drive /preview page: 'Mandarin Grade 8 Design - July 2024 - Revised.pdf'). Drive direct download is permission-locked by the owner, so the PDF was instead fetched via this easylearn.co.ke mirror; WebFetch reported binary/unreadable content but saved the PDF locally, and Claude's Read tool parsed the full text natively (not summarized). Structure verified verbatim against the PDF's SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS table (page xii) and the per-theme strand tables (pages 1-57).

essenceNote: Kenya is part of the international community and learners have the opportunity to learn foreign languages (Arabic, French, German and Mandarin Chinese) in addition to national, official and indigenous languages, acquiring the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing) at a basic (A1/YCT2-equivalent) level in a non-formal, experiential curriculum (verbatim essence statement).

subStrands.name: Active Listening — Articulation, Pronunciation
specificLearningOutcomes: Repeat words and phrases from audio and textual sources
Articulate sounds and words with proper pronunciation
Acknowledge the importance of proper language usage in formal and polite contexts
keyInquiryQuestions: What strategies can you use to improve your pronunciation?

subStrands.name: Active Listening — Chinese Tones, Intonation
specificLearningOutcomes: Replicate vocabulary from various oral texts
Apply appropriate tone and intonation in sentences
Appreciate the role of active listening in communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we enhance our pronunciation skills?

subStrands.name: Interactive Speaking — Active Listening, Nonverbal Cues
specificLearningOutcomes: Restate key words and phrases in varied listening contexts
Apply non-verbal cues appropriately to enhance communication
Exhibit interest in speaking clearly while interacting with others
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you interact effectively with others?

subStrands.name: Oral Expression — Active Listening, Comprehension
specificLearningOutcomes: Distinguish familiar and unfamiliar words and phrases in texts
Respond to simple questions clearly and logically
Appreciate the importance of listening attentively while communicating
keyInquiryQuestions: How can one practise active listening skills?

subStrands.name: Oral Expression — Vocabulary Development, Language Use
specificLearningOutcomes: Repeat words and phrases from varied oral texts
Use appropriate vocabulary and language for different contexts
Appreciate the importance of expressing ideas clearly in oral communication
keyInquiryQuestions: What techniques can enhance speaking clarity?

subStrands.name: Oral Expression — Vocabulary Development, Sentence Construction
specificLearningOutcomes: Recall key information from texts
Construct simple sentences on varied topics in Chinese
Acknowledge the importance of clarity of ideas when communicating
keyInquiryQuestions: What strategies can you use to ensure clarity of ideas during oral communication?

subStrands.name: Listening for Information — Comprehension, Verbal and Non-Verbal Cues
specificLearningOutcomes: Mention keywords and phrases in the depicted context
Examine verbal and non-verbal cues to comprehend information
Acknowledge the importance of listening actively to retain information
keyInquiryQuestions: What listening strategies can you use to enhance comprehension?

subStrands.name: Listening for Information — Active Listening, Summarising
specificLearningOutcomes: Highlight vocabulary from audio-visual texts
Summarise the key information from various oral texts
Show an interest in understanding key information in an aural context
keyInquiryQuestions: How can you improve your ability to retain information while listening?

subStrands.name: Interactive Speaking — Active Listening, Pronunciation (Volume and Tone)
specificLearningOutcomes: Recall words, phrases and expressions from varied texts
Talk about familiar topics using appropriate volume, tone and pronunciation
Exhibit interest in speaking clearly and confidently on various topics
keyInquiryQuestions: What strategies can keep one's audience engaged in an interaction?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Comprehension, Fluency (Speed)
specificLearningOutcomes: List key words, phrases and expressions from a reading text
Read out simple sentences in texts with appropriate speed
Recognize the significance of effective articulation in achieving fluency
keyInquiryQuestions: How can reading fluency be achieved?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Word Recognition, Comprehension
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify vocabulary from reading texts for learning
Read texts on varied themes for comprehension
Exhibit enthusiasm in reading texts fluently for comprehension
keyInquiryQuestions: How does reading fluency enhance communication?

subStrands.name: Reading for Understanding — Vocabulary Development, Comprehension
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline words and phrases from a reading text
Explain key information in a reading comprehension
Appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we enhance understanding while reading texts?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Decoding Words, Fluency
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify words and phrases in texts
Read short texts on familiar topics fluently
Acknowledge the role of reading fluently in enhancing comprehension
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we enhance reading fluency?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Word Recognition, Fluency (Rhythm, Expression, Intonation)
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline words, expressions and phrases from texts
Read simple texts with appropriate expression, intonation and rhythm
Appreciate the value of reading extensively to enhance fluency
keyInquiryQuestions: What strategies can you use to be a fluent reader?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Vocabulary Development, Reading Fluency
specificLearningOutcomes: Compile key words, phrases and expressions in texts
Read simple texts fluently for comprehension
Show interest in applying fluency skills across various types of texts
keyInquiryQuestions: How does reading fluency help in effective communication?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Vocabulary Building, Reading Fluency
specificLearningOutcomes: Categorise keywords and phrases according to the context
Read simple texts on varied themes fluently
Exhibit interest in reading and pronouncing words accurately for fluency
keyInquiryQuestions: How does fluency enhance communication?

subStrands.name: Reading for Understanding — Word Recognition, Comprehension
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline targeted vocabulary from varied texts
Respond to questions from a written text
Propose methods to improve one's reading comprehension
keyInquiryQuestions: What reading strategies can you use to improve comprehension of texts?

subStrands.name: Reading for Fluency — Vocabulary Development, Reading Fluency
specificLearningOutcomes: Highlight key words and phrases in a written text
Read simple texts fluently
Acknowledge the importance of reading fluently for communication
keyInquiryQuestions: What strategies can be used to improve one's fluency?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Orthography, Handwriting (Spelling)
specificLearningOutcomes: Write words and phrases from an audio text
Compose simple texts on various topics legibly and neatly
Appreciate the role of handwriting in communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How can handwriting be enhanced?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Paragraph Writing
specificLearningOutcomes: Compile key words and phrases from varied texts
Compose simple Chinese sentences on a variety of topics
Appreciate the importance of self-evaluation in improving writing
keyInquiryQuestions: What strategies can you use to write effectively?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Mechanics of Writing (Word Order)
specificLearningOutcomes: Enumerate vocabulary relevant to the topic from written texts
Write simple texts on varied topics with appropriate word order
Recognise the importance of writing neatly and legibly
keyInquiryQuestions: How does word order influence readability and coherence of texts?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Word Recognition, Paragraph Writing (Coherence)
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify words, phrases and expressions in written texts
Compose simple texts in an organised and coherent manner
Appreciate the significance of accuracy in written communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How can you ensure clarity and coherence in written texts?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Grammatical Structures
specificLearningOutcomes: Recall words, phrases and expressions from texts
Apply appropriate grammatical structures in written texts
Show interest in using acquired vocabulary to improve writing
keyInquiryQuestions: How can you ensure grammatical accuracy in written texts?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Vocabulary Building, Paragraph Writing (Coherence)
specificLearningOutcomes: Write simple sentences using the targeted vocabulary
Write clear and coherent texts on various themes in Chinese
Develop an interest to express ideas clearly in writing
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you write coherent texts?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Orthography (Rules of Writing)
specificLearningOutcomes: Use appropriate vocabulary to express ideas in writing
Apply various writing conventions in texts
Appreciate the importance of legibility in written communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you enhance readability of texts?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Mechanisms of Writing (Word Order), Handwriting
specificLearningOutcomes: List key words and phrases in written texts
Construct sentences with appropriate word order in varied contexts
Show enthusiasm in writing clearly for effective communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How can you write effectively?

subStrands.name: Guided Writing — Handwriting, Vocabulary and Language Use
specificLearningOutcomes: Enumerate vocabulary in a given context
Utilise contextually appropriate vocabulary in written communication
Develop an appreciation for Chinese characters
keyInquiryQuestions: How can you use vocabulary effectively in writing?

notes: Same 9 themes repeat identically across all 3 strands (Greetings and Introduction, Family, My Surroundings, Time, Fun and Enjoyment, Foods and Drinks, My Body, Weather and Environment, Getting Around) = 27 distinct sub-strands (9 themes x 3 strands), confirmed verbatim from the PDF's own per-theme tables — an exact structural and theme-order match to Mandarin's own Grade 9 design and to French/German's Grade 8 designs. Unlike the per-theme sub-strand tables, this design's front-matter SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS table (page xii) groups sub-strand *types* generically by strand (e.g. 'Active Listening', 'Oral expression', 'Reading for fluency', 'Guided writing') with aggregate lesson counts (Listening & Speaking: Active Listening 6 + Oral expression 9 + Listening for information 6 + Interactive speaking 6 = 27; Reading: Reading for understanding 6 + Reading for fluency 14 = 20 [table shows 6+14=20, though only 18 lessons are itemized across the 9 reading sub-strands in-body — a minor internal inconsistency in the source]; Writing: Guided writing 9 + Exhibitions and Showcase 6 = 15) rather than per-theme names — the per-theme codes/names used here (1.1-1.9, 2.1-2.9, 3.1-3.9) are read directly from each theme's own strand table, the more specific and authoritative source, matching the French/German/Mandarin-Grade-9 precedent. Distinctive to Mandarin: content is presented in hanzi (Chinese characters) with pinyin romanization provided by the curriculum itself throughout (unlike Grade 9 Mandarin, where pinyin had to be supplied independently) — e.g. 您好/早上好/下午好 (greetings), 叔叔/姑姑/舅舅/阿姨/堂弟/表妹 (extended family + professions like 医生/护士/老师), 车站/派出所/学校/邮局/医院/银行/商场 (surroundings), 点/分/半/刻/差 (telling time), 爬山/游泳/钓鱼/骑自行车 (recreation), 烤箱/冰箱/菜板/煮/炒/炸/煎/蒸/炖/烤 (kitchen), 快乐/伤心/生气/兴奋/惊讶/疲倦 (emotions), 山/湖/河/洋/海/大裂谷/沙漠/森林 (physical features), 小汽车/出租车/公交车/自行车/摩托车/火车/驴子/骆驼/走路/飞机 (transport) — all pulled directly from the design's own suggested-learning-experiences tables, not invented independently.
